record.paper_title: Open problems in billiards and quantitative symplectic geometry
record.original_question: For the conformally symplectic cotangent-bundle setting with d_eta-exact Hamiltonians, can one find a physical example fitting the displayed equations of motion, and what is the mechanical meaning of those equations?

evidence.quote: A question is whether there is any physical example

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a smooth manifold and let $T^*M$ denote its cotangent bundle, equipped with the canonical Liouville one-form $\lambda$ (so that $\omega_0 = -d\lambda$ is the standard symplectic form). Fix a closed one-form $\eta$ on $T^*M$ and consider the twisted differential
$$d_\eta \alpha := d\alpha + \eta \wedge \alpha,$$
so that $d_\eta^2 = 0$. A locally conformally symplectic (lcs) structure of Lee form $\eta$ on $T^*M$ is a non-degenerate two-form $\omega$ satisfying $d_\eta \omega = 0$; on $T^*M$ one may take $\omega = -d_\eta \lambda$. For a smooth function $H : T^*M \to \mathbb{R}$ (a "$d_\eta$-exact Hamiltonian"), define the conformally Hamiltonian vector field $X_H$ by
$$\iota_{X_H}\omega = -d_\eta H = -(dH + H\eta).$$
In Darboux-type coordinates $(q^i, p_i)$ on $T^*M$ with $\eta = \eta_i\, dq^i + \tilde\eta^i\, dp_i$, the resulting equations of motion take the form
$$\dot q^i = \frac{\partial H}{\partial p_i} + H\, \tilde\eta^i, \qquad \dot p_i = -\frac{\partial H}{\partial q^i} - H\, \eta_i.$$

Problem. Exhibit an explicit physical mechanical system (i.e., a choice of base manifold $M$, Hamiltonian $H$, and Lee form $\eta$ on $T^*M$) whose dynamics is governed by the above conformally symplectic equations of motion, and describe the mechanical interpretation of the additional terms $H\tilde\eta^i$ and $H\eta_i$ (for instance as friction, dissipation, or other physical effects).
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted search located general theory of conformally Hamiltonian systems on cotangent bundles and related contact/scaling-symmetry reductions (e.g., n-body type examples via moment-of-inertia scalings), but did not produce a definitive matching physical mechanical example with the precise $d_\eta$-exact Hamiltonian equations stated, together with an established mechanical interpretation. The question therefore appears to remain open in the form posed.

status_evidence.title: Locally conformally symplectic reduction of the cotangent bundle
status_evidence.snippet: Studies lcs structures on cotangent bundles and their reduction, providing framework but not an explicit mechanical example.
status_evidence.claim: General lcs framework on T^*M is developed, but no specific physical mechanical realization of the displayed equations is given.

status_evidence.title: Relative equilibria for Scaling Symmetries and Central Configurations
status_evidence.snippet: Hamiltonian systems on cotangent bundles with scaling symmetries reduce to contact Hamiltonian systems; examples include two-body and n-body problems.
status_evidence.claim: Related conformal/contact reductions admit physical examples, but the precise lcs $d_\eta$-exact mechanical interpretation is not pinned down.
